ratios.quote: Our Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio was 4.12, with the covenant requirement at 5.00 at the end of March 31, 2026.

parsed.notes: The Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio is defined as Consolidated Funded Indebtedness less unrestricted cash, divided by Consolidated EBITDA. Because cash is netted, it is classified as net leverage. Under the June 2025 Amendment, the maximum steps down from 5.00x (through June 30, 2026) to 4.75x at September 30, 2026, 4.50x at December 31, 2026, and 4.00x from March 31, 2027 onward. The same ratio also sets the interest margin, the commitment fee and the Securitization Facility fees; those pricing uses are excluded.
